title: Export data (DB + photos) to zip
description: Zip the Room DB file and the photos directory, and write it via SAF to a location the warden picks.
acceptanceCriteria: Export produces a single zip file at a user-chosen location
Zip contains both the DB file and all referenced photos

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Building alongside LODGY-29 (import) - one BackupManager (backup/BackupManager.kt) covers both directions, matching DESIGN.md 4.8. No new dependency needed, java.util.zip covers zipping. Export flow: PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(FULL) on the live Room db to flush WAL into the main file, then stream lodgy.db plus every file under filesDir/photos/ into a ZipOutputStream written straight to the SAF destination the warden picks via ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument - no intermediate temp file.

BackupManager.export() writes a single zip with a `lodgy.db` entry and one `photos/<filename>` entry per photo (AC2). The destination Uri comes from CreateDocument's SAF picker, so it lands wherever the warden picks - Downloads, an SD card, a Drive-synced folder (AC1). Entry point: More tab -> 'Backup & Restore' (ui/backup/BackupScreen.kt, BackupViewModel.kt), reachable via the new BACKUP_ROUTE in LodgyNavHost. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still queued (session-wide emulator/adb limitation) - worth confirming on a real device that the produced zip actually opens and both entries extract cleanly, and that wal_checkpoint doesn't hiccup under concurrent app usage.

PASS - both AC confirmed on-device. More -> Backup & Restore -> Export opened the standard SAF CreateDocument picker with a sensible default name (lodgy-backup-2026-09-03.zip), saved to Downloads without error (AC1). Pulled the zip via adb and verified with Python's zipfile: 4 entries (lodgy.db + 3 photos/*.jpg), zip.testzip() returns None (no CRC/integrity errors, opens cleanly), and lodgy.db's wardens/tenants/hostels tables are all readable and intact - the wal_checkpoint(FULL) the developer mentioned worked correctly. Cross-checked one photo filename against the live DB's tenants.photoPath column and confirmed it's Test Tenant's actual saved photo, satisfying 'contains... all referenced photos' (AC2). Observation, not a fail: the zip also contains 2 photo files that aren't referenced by any tenant/DB row (confirmed via query - Test Tenant's idProofPhotoPath is still null, Ravi/Priya have no photos at all) - these are orphaned files from the same PhotoStorage-persists-on-pick-not-on-save behavior already reported on LODGY-11 (a picked/captured photo is copied into app-private storage immediately, before the tenant form is ever saved, so an abandoned pick leaves a permanent dangling file). AC2 only requires referenced photos be included, which holds, but every future export will keep including these orphans and any others like them since nothing ever cleans up unreferenced photo files - worth a follow-up cleanup pass once LODGY-11's save-timing issue is fixed, not blocking this ticket on it.
